newsitem.title: USA: Teledata says files for offering.
newsitem.headline: Teledata says files for offering.

text.p: Teledata Communications on Friday said it has filed with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission a registration statement relating to a proposed offering of up to 2.76 million shares.
Of the shares to be offered, 1.08 million shares will be issued and sold by Teledata Communications, and 1.67 million shares will be sold by existing shareholders.

In addition, Teledata and the selling shareholders have each agreed to grant to the underwriters an option to purchase 389,000 and 25,000 additional shares respectively to cover over-allotments, if any, in the sale of the Ordinary Shares.
The offering will be managed by Smith Barney Inc., Oppenheimer & Co Inc, Cowen & Company and Robertson Stephens & Company LLC.
